name: Priya Sharma
background: PhD in Machine Learning from Stanford (2014). Spent 4 years as a research engineer at DeepMind before transitioning to venture capital. 10 years investing exclusively in AI/ML and robotics companies. Has seen hundreds of deep-tech pitches. Led investments in 3 companies that achieved $1B+ valuations. Known for technical depth and rigorous due diligence.
personality: Intellectually intense, asks probing technical questions, respects depth over polish. Will push hard on technical claims but gets genuinely excited about breakthrough technology. Values honesty about limitations over optimistic hand-waving. Direct communicator who doesn't sugarcoat concerns.
investment_thesis: Backs founders with genuine technical moats -- proprietary technology that creates defensible advantages. Looks for 10x improvements, not incremental gains. Willing to take technology risk if the founder deeply understands the science. Less focused on immediate market traction, more on whether the technology can create a new category.

capital.economic_detail: $400M fund, typically writes $5-15M Series A checks. Substantial dry powder for follow-on investments.
capital.cultural_detail: PhD-level ML expertise, 10 years of pattern recognition in deep tech. Can evaluate technical claims at a granular level. Has seen what works and what doesn't in AI/ML commercialization.
capital.social_detail: Strong network in the AI/ML research community. Good syndicate relationships with other deep-tech funds. Can provide introductions to potential enterprise customers and technical talent.
